name: Mattu University
location: Split across Mattu, also called Metu, and a second site in Bedele
founded: University status from 2011, though some sources point to earlier college roots
distanceNote: A long western road trip toward the Illubabor area, with Bedele as a second campus site along the way.
campuses: Metu serves as the main campus, with a second site in Bedele, which one you belong to depends entirely on your program.
knownFor: Operating as a genuine two site university across Metu and Bedele in western Oromia
Agriculture and applied science programs suited to the region's greener, more humid environment
Serving a wide western catchment area with limited nearby alternatives
whatToExpect: Your actual daily experience depends heavily on which campus your program uses, confirm this specifically on your placement documents rather than assuming Metu and Bedele offer the same setting.
Town services at either site are smaller than in bigger western hubs like Nekemte or Jimma, students should set modest expectations for shopping and entertainment options.
The rainy season brings real mud and can affect local transport between and within campus areas, sturdy footwear matters more here than students expect.
As with several regional universities built to expand access quickly, facility quality varies by department, ask current students in your specific field for an honest picture.
tips: Double check your exact campus assignment, Metu or Bedele, on your official placement letter before you travel or pack.
Bring real rain gear and sturdy shoes, the wet season here genuinely affects daily movement around campus.
studentFit: Mattu University suits students comfortable navigating a two site system in western Oromia and drawn to agriculture or applied science programs in a greener, more humid environment. It fits people from the wider western region wanting accessible higher education close to home. Students who want a single unified campus without the added logistics of two sites, or who need more established city amenities nearby, should weigh this carefully.
strengths: Operating as a genuine two site university across Metu and Bedele in western Oromia
Agriculture and applied science programs suited to the region's greener, more humid environment
Serving a wide western catchment area with limited nearby alternatives
